stage.description: Widened from the original const OPTIMIZED to an enum so the precision-grease route's step 14 (stage NON_INFERIORITY_PASSED, added in batch 0 and deliberately chosen over reusing OPTIMIZED) can carry the same contract. The name marks WHERE the optimization REQUEST is registered on that route; it is NOT a claim that a non-inferiority conclusion has been reached (E4=B: this step registers the request and its non-inferiority method contract, and no candidate, optimum, or non-inferiority verdict is produced by this Phase 3 artifact). Purely additive: OPTIMIZED stays legal and the six oil routes keep validating against it byte for byte.

objective_type.description: Both values stay legal. The precision-grease route DEFAULTS to CONSTRAINT_SATISFACTION (satisfy performance first, then stay under the cost ceiling) rather than MULTI_OBJECTIVE, because putting cost and performance side by side as equal objectives is the wrong trade for a performance-first product. JSON Schema has no force behind a default, so that default is implemented in the skill policy layer (optimization_policy.py), not here.

ni_limits.description: Reserved / no consumer in this pack: no skill, builder, validator or engine reads ni_limits, so a value written here is never a non-inferiority verdict. The authoritative field for a non-inferiority judgement is the engine input contract domains/lubricant/schemas/optimization_input.schema.json, non_inferiority[].minimum_margin; the artifact-level field must never be used as the basis of a decision. Kept (rather than deleted) so artifacts already carrying it stay valid; all fields optional, and once present each must be numeric with a margin above zero.

variance_reference.description: Optional, precision-grease route only. The variance assessment (variance.schema.json variance_id) whose verdict admits this round to the optimization: a round that is UNDERPOWERED or REPLICATE_INCONSISTENT must not be optimized. Optional so every existing oil artifact stays valid.

trust_region.description: Optional, precision-grease route only. The model's applicability boundary (trust region) the recommendation must stay inside, in the deterministic engine's box form. A recommended point outside this region is an extrapolation and must be removed or explicitly degraded by the engine, never recommended silently. Optional so every existing oil artifact stays valid.
